blocks.text: Screen recordings that look like professional product videos

Screen Studio solves a specific problem beautifully: raw screen recordings look boring and hard to follow. Hit record, do your thing, and Screen Studio automatically adds smooth zoom on clicks, cursor highlighting, and cinematic motion that guides the viewer's eye to what matters.

The output quality rivals what a motion designer would produce manually - but it takes seconds instead of hours. For product teams creating demo videos, documentation, and marketing content, this means professional-looking videos without professional video skills.

Screen Studio is Mac-only and unapologetically focused on its core use case. There is no bloated feature set or complex interface - just a record button, smart defaults, and export options that produce ready-to-publish video.
Smooth, cinematic zoom on clicks and cursor movements
Highlight clicks, smooth cursor movement, and size adjustments
Add beautiful backgrounds, rounded corners, and shadows
Record at up to 120fps for butter-smooth playback
Export as MP4, GIF, or optimized for social media platforms
Picture-in-picture camera feed with customizable positioning

Every product demo and tutorial video we create goes through Screen Studio. The automatic zoom and motion effects transform amateur screen recordings into content that looks like it had a professional editor.
